scope: Full 27.5-second object-factored projection v1 post-encode verification
summary: All 660 frames were projected and encoded, but the first fresh experiment stopped during FFV1 verification because Matroska omitted nb_frames and the probe expected that field unconditionally.
evidence: Both object-factored-27p5s.mp4 and object-factored-27p5s-lossless.mkv were written before the verifier raised KeyError: nb_frames.
The failure occurred after encoding and before manifest promotion; no WORKING claim was made.
lessons: Lossless Matroska verification must request ffprobe count_frames and fall back from nb_frames to nb_read_frames.
limitations: The failed run has no completed acceptance manifest and is not a deliverable.
next_actions: Use the corrected count_frames verifier and rerun the complete projection in a new experiment directory.
